featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been to this spa 3 times in the last 2 months. It is a good place. A striking feature of the spa is that it is simple and does not have the unnecessary frills; therefore the cost is reasonable.

4 massage cubicles with the whole interior of raw wood give the place a unique look. Illumination is neither too dark nor too bright - so it helps you to forget your stress when the masseuse is working.

The staff know their job well, the towels and mats are clean, disposables are used and, above all, the place is quiet. So it is expected that you be silent or speak in whispers inside the spa. In case you experience pain during treatment, indicate it very softly and the masseuse will stop or avoid those areas. The therapists are very receptive and even a hand sign by the client is well understood.

And for God's sake, don't get into a chitchat with the masseuse! This is a spa, not a bar!

Timings are convenient but they are very strict in closing on time because of municipality rules applicable to all shops in the locality.  Late comers are not entertained.

Weekends (Sat evenings and Sundays) are crazy busy - so if you go without an appointment, you may be disappointed.

Woodhouse is a decent place. Go with the right purpose and expectations and enjoy your time.
